description: Set one setting/secret the app needs (an env var). Creates a new version: settings only, in seconds, or, when the setting is one the app reads while it is built (NEXT_PUBLIC_*, VITE_*, EXPO_PUBLIC_* and similar, or a name in deploy.json secrets.buildTime), a rebuild of the live version that takes minutes; the result then has rebuild: true. Values are encrypted and never shown again. Replaces an existing value with the same key; every other setting is kept.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.

name: set_secret
title: Set a secret
